MECHANISM & EXPLANATION (CROSS-CHECK AUDIT)

Shown: selected historical E6 media. These clips are illustrations, not the E7 benchmark grid. Earlier temporal mixing across clean frame 0 produced global luma ringing (27.4 frames; flicker index 0.505; #5634). E7 corrected that boundary: its temporal donor arm had 8/16 clean clips, but 0/16 within 10% of the real period.

E7 spatial donor result: Raj reports 8 targets × 2 seeds per arm. Spatial slo transfer had 8/16 clean clips and 6/16 within 10% of the real period (median P/P_real 1.05); plain noise had 4/16 clean and 0/16 within 10% (median 0.47). Clean means pend_acf ok, flicker < 0.08, and measure_pend agrees within 10%.

Partial clock copying: With a 10/7-sped-up donor, the median ratio fell to 0.68 (0.70 expected). The paired transfer fraction f = 0.93 uses only 3 targets, with CI [-2.2, 1.15]: underpowered. Raj reports no general noise-shaping fix; this route needs a matching real donor recording. Human report #6167; no independent remeasurement or NVIDIA-scoreboard pass is claimed here.
